confidence.description: How sure the assessment is, from 0 to 100.

consistent.description: The evidence fits the description and the loss date.

estimate.description: The loss the evidence shows, in whole units of the market currency.

human_care.description: Signs of distress or vulnerability: a person should take the case.

reason.description: One plain sentence for the customer saying what was seen.

recommend.description:
`approve` when the evidence clearly shows an insured loss of the kind described, otherwise
`refer`. There is no decline: people decide declines.

urgent.description: An injury, a hospital stay, an emergency abroad or other urgent need.
